ruled_out_vectors.vector: Malicious SingleProvider hook returns fake sqrtPriceX96 to rig swap execution price
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Pool hook is set by pool creator who is also the LP. Attacker creating malicious hook = trading against themselves. No external victim. SingleProviderPoolType.swapByInput() L323 trusts hook by design.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: snapPrice sandwich in DynamicHelper — move price via addLiquidity then extract via swap
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Guard at DynamicHelper.sol:245 requires poolState.liquidity == 0. Additional guards at L261-271 check for ANY initialized tick with liquidity between current and target price. No extraction possible when liquidity is zero. M-07 was resolved.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Direct swap bypasses pricing bounds enforced by hooks
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Known as CP-004. beforeSwap stores amount in transient slot, afterSwap reads it. Only bypassed when afterSwap flag disabled — requires token creator misconfiguration. Tier B at best.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Round-trip rounding extraction in DynamicPool via many tiny swaps
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Input amounts round UP (getAmount0Delta roundUp=true). Output amounts round DOWN (getAmount1Delta roundUp=false). Fee amounts use mulDivRoundingUp. All favor pool. Standard Uniswap V3 rounding. SwapMath.sol:56-77.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Round-trip rounding extraction in SingleProviderPool via buy-sell cycle
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: calculateFixedInput uses FullMath.mulDiv (rounds down output). calculateFixedOutput uses FullMath.mulDivRoundingUp (rounds up input). Both favor pool. SingleProviderHelper.sol:107-112, 197-203.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Flash loan + swap reentrancy — borrow, swap at manipulated price, repay
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Flash loan flag (bit 11) doesn't overlap swap flags (bits 2-6), swaps allowed during callback by design. No price state stale during callback. Attacker can't profit from self-initiated swaps due to IL and fees.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Flash loan fee denomination mismatch — fee computed in wrong token
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Fee token from hook is validated independently. Balance checks at L3310-3315 verify loanToken and feeToken balances separately. Fee stored at L3375-3378 with correct denomination. No MUX-style mismatch.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Stale/unbounded oracle feed in SingleProvider hook pricing
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: AMM only bounds check MIN_SQRT_RATIO < price < MAX_SQRT_RATIO. Hook quality is hook developer's responsibility. No built-in oracle in the AMM framework. Pool creator = LP = bears the risk.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Slippage/deadline parameter bypass to execute swap at worse price
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: limitAmount enforced in _finalizeSwapCollectFundsAndDisburse: input swaps require amountOut >= limitAmount (L2156), output swaps require amountIn <= limitAmount (L2171). Deadline at L1980.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Reentrancy during queued hook fee transfer — reenter AMM with stale state
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: tokensOwed decremented before transfer (L3129). Pool state fully committed before queue execution. Queue zeroed at L3189. Any reentrant call operates on fully committed state. No stale value exploitable.

theft_theses.thesis: Flash loan -> swap at extreme price on SingleProvider pool via malicious hook -> extract from price difference
Sandwich snapPrice in DynamicPool addLiquidity to extract value from subsequent swaps
Exploit fee denomination mismatch in flash loan cross-token fee path for amplified extraction
